stories.headline: Nvidia board investigates report that Chinese intelligence targeted CEO Jensen Huang

sources.body: Nvidia’s board said Sunday it would investigate reports that CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence operation. The New York Times reported Huang had an affair with an executive US intelligence believed was gathering information for Beijing. Huang will remain CEO during the inquiry and has pledged cooperation.
sources.headline: Nvidia to probe reports that Chinese intelligence targeted CEO Jensen Huang

sources.body:
CEO reportedly ‌had close relationship ‌with a Chinese businesswoman who passed information to ‌Beijing

Nvidia said ⁠on Sunday it “is initiating an independent investigation in light of recent reporting that founder and CEO Jensen Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort”.

The New York Times reported in ​October that Donald Trump had been briefed last year on intelligence that Huang ‌had a close relationship ‌with a Chinese businesswoman who passed information to ‌Beijing.

Speaking to reporters on Sunday, Trump downplayed the revelations about Huang, who is an influential adviser to the president on artificial intelligence, saying: “I think he’s an honorable guy. I think he probably has an excuse for it.”

Trump also brushed off a question about whether he now regrets not acting on the intelligence when he was briefed on it, and suggested that he would be happy to take Huang with him on a trip to Asia next week. “I haven’t heard he’s done anything wrong,” Trump said. “He dealt with somebody. But, you know, so does everybody else.”

Republican lawmakers have expressed more alarm, asking Huang to give the House foreign affairs and intelligence committees a closed-door briefing next week on Nvidia’s “security protocols against foreign adversary espionage” and his relationship with Alice Huang or Huang Le, an executive at a Singapore-based datacenter company called Megaspeed, who is of no relation to the Nvidia CEO. She had previously been suspected of smuggling Nvidia chips to China, prompting American officials to surveil and monitor her.

Those officials have determined that she was acting as a Chinese intelligence asset, passing commercial information to Beijing, the New York Times reported, citing unnamed sources.

The company’s board said in a statement on Sunday that, while it has no reason to believe that either US national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised, its inquiry will examine all available information.

“The Board prioritizes US national and economic security, which is paramount to the interests of NVIDIA and its shareholders,” the company said. “The Board has confidence in Jensen and his leadership team and will provide further updates as appropriate.”

Huang fully ‌supports the review and has committed to cooperating with it, it added.

Axios reported on ​Sunday, citing a draft email by Huang to employees, that Huang admitted to having a romantic relationship with a suspected Chinese spy and took full ⁠responsibility for his actions.

“I was unfaithful to my ​wife. My ​actions hurt her ​and our children. There is no excuse ​for what ‌I did,” ​Huang said ​in the draft email also seen by Reuters.

Nvidia did not immediately respond to a request for comment on the Axios report.

The Times reported on Sunday that a memo drafted by US secretary of state Marco Rubio circulated among top policymakers in the Trump administration last spring, citing intelligence that the businesswoman who had a relationship with Nvidia’s chief executive was a spy for China’s ministry of state security. Despite those concerns, Huang was invited to join Trump’s delegation when he traveled to China in May. Huang and his wife, Lori Huang, were also invited to a state dinner at the White House in September for Xi Jinping and seated at the top table with Trump and China’s president.
sources.headline: Nvidia opens investigation after report CEO Jensen Huang was target of foreign intelligence

stories.headline: Drone attack halts production at Iraq’s Khor Mor gas field

sources.body:
The strike leaves more than 70 percent of northern Iraq’s Kurdish region without power.

A drone attack on the Khor Mor gasfield in the semi-autonomous Kurdish region of northern Iraq has caused a fire at the facility and cut power to the region, according to Iraqi and Kurdish officials.

The Sunday night attack left more than 70 percent of the Kurdish region without power.

It was not clear who was responsible for the attack or whether it was related to the United States and Israel’s war on Iran.

Al Jazeera’s fact-checking agency Sanad has verified footage of smoke and flames rising from the vicinity of the gasfield in the Sulaimaniyah governorate.

Omid Ahmed, spokesperson for the Kurdistan Regional Government’s Ministry of Electricity, said the attack suspended gas supply to power plants in the cities of Erbil, Sulaimaniyah, Bazian, Chamchamal and Duhok, the official Iraqi News Agency (INA) reported.

The strike knocked between 2,500 and 2,800 megawatts of electricity generation off the grid, he said.

He added that the ministry would provide electricity to critical facilities, such as hospitals and water treatment plants, by operating hydroelectric power stations and other plants that run on alternative fuel.

Al Jazeera’s Peter Smith, reporting from Baghdad, cited security sources as saying the explosive-laden drone struck the Khor Mor gas storage facility, reducing the energy grid’s capacity by 70 to 80 percent.

Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi said there were no casualties as a result of the attack, based on an initial assessment, the INA reported.

Al-Zaidi also directed that a joint investigative committee be formed with the relevant authorities in the Kurdish region to investigate the circumstances surrounding the attack, INA reported.

The attack comes amid heightened regional tensions. A drone strike hit the same facility last year, with no group having claimed responsibility.
sources.headline: Drone attack suspends production at Iraq’s Khor Mor gasfield

stories.headline: At least seven killed and more than 100 injured in Egypt train collision

sources.body:
At least seven people have died in a train crash near the Egyptian city of Giza, with more than 100 injured.

The country's railway authority said two trains travelling south from Giza and Cairo collided, causing several carriages to derail and fall down an embankment.

Images from the scene showed people looking inside overturned carriages for injured passengers as a massive emergency response was launched.

Egyptian President Abdul Fattah al-Sisi said he had ordered state authorities to "investigate the circumstances of the accident, and hold accountable anyone found to have been negligent".

The public prosecutor's office warned the death toll could rise.

The government said hospitals in the area had been put "on heightened alert" as they dealt with a massive influx of patients.

Egypt's health minister Dr Khaled Abdel Ghaffar said people were being treated for broken bones and head injuries.

The Egyptian Red Crescent said it was providing aid and psychological support to victims and their families at the scene.

The driver of one of the trains was among those who died in the crash, the ministry confirmed.

The first train involved in the crash was travelling from Giza to Fayoum, south of Cairo, when it crashed into the rear of another service heading south from Cairo to Aswan, which was stationary on the tracks.

Images from the scene showed some carriages had overturned, with the body of at least one appearing to have split in two.

Trains between Giza and the Upper Egypt region were suspended as cranes were dispatched to remove the wrecked trains. The railway authority has not said how long it expects this to take.

The collision occurred in the area between Kafr Ammar and Al-Raqqa stations in Al-Ayyat, close to where Egypt's deadliest train tragedy occurred in February 2002, when a fire engulfed a passenger train travelling from Cairo to Luxor.

In that incident, more than 370 people were officially reported killed, although some estimates put the toll considerably higher.

Two further crashes in the area in 2009 killed dozens more.

There were calls in Egypt on Sunday for the transport minister to resign over the latest deadly rail disaster.

Foreign leaders and dignitaries have shared condolences and support for the victims.

Saudi Arabia's ministry of foreign affairs expressed "solidarity" with Egypt and wished those hurt a speedy recovery.

Turkey's ambassador to Egypt wrote on X that he extended "heartfelt condolences and sincere sympathy" to the victims, their families, and the Egyptian people.
sources.headline: Seven dead and more than 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt

sources.body:
President orders prompt investigation after one train derails in collision in al-Ayyat about 50km from Cairo

Seven people were killed and at least 125 injured when two trains collided on Sunday south of the Egyptian capital, Cairo, officials said.

The crash occurred in al-Ayyat district in Giza province, about 50km (30 miles) south of Cairo, when a train travelling to Fayoum province crashed into the rear of a train heading to the southern province of Aswan, according to the transport ministry.

An inspection indicated that the Cairo-Aswan train had been stationary on the same track, officials said.

The health ministry gave the casualty toll, adding more than 70 of the injured were discharged after receiving treatment.

Train derailments and crashes are common in Egypt, where the railway system has a history of mismanagement and poor maintenance of equipment. In recent years the government has announced modernisation initiatives to improve its railways.

Ayman Gamal, a resident of Kafr Girza in al-Ayyat where the crash occurred, said people rushed to the scene, pulled out survivors and called ambulances.

Gamal said he saw about 80 of the injured being taken by ambulances to hospital. Some passengers were trapped inside one of the carriages of the stationary train and died, he said.

Egypt’s president, Abdel Fatah al-Sisi, said in a social media post that he had ordered a prompt investigation.

Outside al-Wasta central hospital in Beni Suef province, where some of the injured were taken for treatment, survivors said passengers were in shock and struggling to breathe because of all the dust that was kicked up. Nearby villagers eventually got them out, they said.

Farha Gamal, a survivor who was inside the Fayyoum train, said she saw some of the passengers who appeared dead and others were struggling to find their way out of the car. “There were other cars that were completely mangled,” she said in an interview.

Emergency teams and cranes were dispatched to the crash site to clear the wreckage and restore train services to their normal schedule as soon as possible, the Egyptian railway authority said.

Last September, a train driver and his assistant were injured after two freight trains collided in the same district.

Egypt’s deadliest train crash was in 2002 when more than 300 people were killed after a fire broke out on an overnight train journeying from Cairo to southern Egypt.
sources.headline: Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven

stories.headline: Pope Leo criticizes Milei’s austerity measures during Argentina visit

sources.body:
Pontiff tells Argentina’s president the economy must benefit all on second stop of 12-day Latin America tour

Pope Leo XIV has delivered a stinging critique of Argentine president Javier Milei’s harsh austerity measures, insisting growth must benefit all in a speech met with rapturous applause in Buenos Aires.

“The economy must be at the service of the people, rather than people being at the service of the economy,” he said on Sunday, shortly after landing in Argentina on the second leg of a Latin America tour.

Leo stressed the plight of those who, “despite hard work, nonetheless struggle to meet their household’s needs”.

He spoke out in defence of the poor and pensioners, insisting that “particular concern be shown for those affected by illness, dependency and disability” – a veiled reference to the government’s controversial cuts to disability assistance.

He also told Milei, known for his foul-mouthed diatribes, that strengthening democracy required a “willingness to listen” and the “careful use of words”.

Leo, 71, is on an ambitious 12-day tour of the continent, just three weeks after undergoing surgery for lung cancer .

The visit is the first by a pontiff to Argentina in nearly four decades, and Leo was met with calls to help mend deep divisions in the country after three years of austerity under Milei.

Argentina is the home country of the late pope, Francis, who Milei famously insulted for his pro-poor teachings.

Leo said he was “retracing” Francis’s steps.

Argentines are hoping the leader of the world’s 1.4 billion Catholics will help unite the country, which is bitterly divided between supporters and opponents of Milei.

“Just like the World Cup unites us, hopefully the pope will too,” said Liliana Deblauwe, a 68-year-old retired teacher who waited with hundreds of people to see the pope visit a monument to liberation hero Jose de San Martin.

Hundreds more chanting “Papa Leon” (Spanish for Leo) gathered outside the presidential palace, where he was hosted by Milei.

Brian Inacio Rodriguez, a 26-year-old job seeker, spent five days travelling overland from Ushuaia, at the very tip of South America, to see the pontiff.

He said he hoped he brought “much peace to Argentina”.

Leo arrived in Buenos Aires from Uruguay, where he began his first trip as pope to Latin America, the world’s most Catholic continent which is becoming increasingly secular.

In Uruguay, he condemned drug violence and urged an end to child poverty.

In Buenos Aires, he insisted on the importance of “personal integrity” in public office, stressing that “corruption undermines the confidence of citizens in their institutions.”

The Argentine stage of his visit aims to boost the flagging faith of a country left disappointed by Francis’s failure to visit during his papacy.

It will also act as a litmus test of support for the church. In a recent University of Buenos Aires poll, 57.7% of people identified as Catholic, down from about 90% in the 1960s.

Leo will visit a home for disabled people and a prison and celebrate three open-air masses.
sources.headline: Pope Leo delivers stinging rebuke of Milei’s austerity measures during Argentina visit

sources.body: Pope Leo XIV arrived in Argentina on Sunday from Uruguay, where his tour began, facing calls to help bridge divisions after three years of austerity under President Javier Milei. The visit to Buenos Aires is the first by a pontiff to the late Pope Francis’ homeland in nearly four decades.
sources.headline: Pope Leo criticises Milei’s austerity in Argentina, says growth must benefit all

stories.headline: Poland opens terrorism investigation into Kraków shooting

sources.body:
Six people killed in attack probably inspired by far right, according to officials, as police say suspect’s parents and sister found dead at his home

Polish prosecutors have opened a terrorism investigation after a 24-year-old man opened fire in a busy market square in Kraków, killing six people including a Briton and injuring 17, in an attack that authorities said was probably inspired by far-right ideologies.

Police confirmed on Sunday that three people found dead at the gunman’s home after the attack on Saturday afternoon were his father, 53, mother, 52, and sister, 21.

As two days of national mourning began, the national prosecutor’s office said on social media it had launched an investigation into “the killing of six people … using a firearm, and the attempted murder of many others, including police officers, this act constituting a terrorist offence”.

The rare mass shooting has shocked a country that was considered safer than many of its European neighbours, and has deepened concern after several school stabbings in October that left one woman dead and which officials said were linked to extremist content online.

The Kraków suspect, a Polish national named in local media as Michal O, drove into the city’s main square in the heart of the old town, which is usually packed with tourists, at top speed at about 3pm on Saturday. Wearing military-style fatigues and a bulletproof vest, he started shooting at random as he took what the Kraków police spokesperson Katarzyna Cisło described as a “wild ride” around the square.

The interior minister, Marcin Kierwiński, said the suspect, who was apprehended and taken to hospital after being wounded in an exchange of fire with police, was fascinated with far-right ideologies and held “very radical” and “ultra-nationalistic” views.

Four women and two men were killed, including a British citizen, Polish police said. Three of the victims were Polish women. Krzysztof Klęczar, a regional official, said on Sunday that a 51-year-old Austrian woman had also been killed and the British victim was a 32-year-old man.

Five of the wounded are foreign nationals from Britain, Austria, Germany, Portugal and Russia.

Two police ⁠officers were also among the injured, one of whom was in a serious condition. The suspect underwent surgery in hospital, where he was under heavy police guard.

The bodies of the suspect’s parents and sister were found at the family home in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski, a town about 100 miles north-east of Kraków. Police said they had probably died of gunshot wounds.

Mourners left candles in tribute to victims in the square, which was still partially cordoned off on Sunday. Flags across the country were lowered to half mast, as were European flags outside the European Commission in Brussels “in solidarity with the Polish people”, the commission said.

The Polish defence minister, Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz, called the shooting an “act of terror” against the people of Kraków, Poland’s second largest city, which receives 15 million visitors a year, most of them passing through the main square.
sources.headline: Polish prosecutors open terrorism investigation into Kraków shooting

sources.body: Poland on Sunday launched a terror probe into the mass shooting in Krakow the day before, in which six people were killed and many more were injured. Authorities have said that the 24-year-old suspect, who used a semi-automatic rifle in his killing spree, was “fascinated by far-right ideologies”. He is currently in critical condition in hospital. FRANCE 24 journalist Adrien Sariat reports from Poland.
sources.headline: Poland in shock after 6 killed in Krakow far-right shooting

stories.headline: Democratic gains reshape power in state legislatures

sources.body: The blue wave crashed through statehouses across the country Tuesday — carrying political and policy ramifications that will reverberate for years. Democrats flipped more than 500 state legislative seats and won control of at least a dozen legislative chambers, establishing new governing trifectas in Michigan, Arizona, Pennsylvania, Minnesota, Wisconsin and Nevada. They captured legislative chambers in Texas, Georgia and North Carolina — states long dominated by Republican lawmakers. And they picked up even more legislative seats in deep blue strongholds like New York, California and Illinois. The victories give Democrats an opening to pursue long-stalled agendas on housing costs and public education, along with new leverage in fights over taxing wealthy people and corporations and regulating artificial intelligence. Their gains will also reshape the country’s redistricting wars — and test whether Democrats can turn their backlash-fueled victories into changes voters can feel in their daily lives. “We had a generational opportunity to shift the power in our states and to affect change and we did just that,” Democratic Legislative Campaign Committee President Heather Williams said. “ We ran the table. It's amazing.” The scale of the victory is historic. In New York, Democrats are on track for their biggest state Senate majority since 1846, when they were running against the Whigs. In Texas, they won the state House for the first time since 2002. Arizona will have its first Democratic trifecta since the 1960s. And Democrats flipped Georgia's House, the first chamber Democrats have taken back in the Deep South in the modern era. Altogether, the party won more seats than in any year since the post-Watergate campaign of 1974. The gains represent the most seismic change in state capitals since Republicans shellacked Democrats nationwide in 2010, picking up nearly 700 state legislative seats and flipping 20 chambers. They used that power in the ensuing years to entrench conservative policies and redraw legislative maps in their favor in wide swaths of the country. Wisconsin Republicans, for example, swept every statewide office and won control of both legislative chambers that year, clearing the way to enact a far-reaching conservative agenda that remade the state over the ensuing decade. On Tuesday, Democrats flipped both legislative chambers. “This is an incredible moment for the state of Wisconsin and the country,” said Wisconsin Assembly Minority Leader Greta Neubauer, who’s expected to become speaker next year. ”We are going to use this power to deliver for the people of our state and demonstrate that government can be a force for good in their lives and things are different when Democrats are in charge.” Democrats have been steadily clawing their way back to power in state capitals in recent election cycles, including picking up 31 seats in special elections and Virginia’s 2025 legislative elections after Donald Trump returned to the White House. After Tuesday, they now control a narrow majority of at least 51 state legislative chambers, up from 29 when Trump first took office in 2016, according to the DLCC. But newly empowered Democratic state lawmakers will face a challenging political and economic landscape with voters angry at elected officials of all partisan stripes as they face pocketbook woes and government failings. Veteran Minnesota Republican strategist Gregg Peppin, who worked on state Senate races this cycle, said the results there largely hinged on what voters were most angry about: the state’s massive fraud scandals under Democratic governance, or a deeply unpopular president. Ultimately, Democrats padded their state Senate majority by five seats and won control of the House. “Clearly we found out they were more fed up with Donald Trump than they were with fraud,” Peppin said. “Everybody’s just worn out from the guy, I think Republicans too. It’s just time to turn the page.” In Arizona, Rep. Oscar De Los Santos, who’s poised to become speaker of the House when lawmakers reconvene in Phoenix next year, said they have a robust agenda planned given their long time in the political wilderness. “We have sixty years of pent-up ideas that we have not been able to move,” he said. “There's a bunch of legislation that we've got ready to go.” Among the items on the agenda: banning corporate landlords from buying homes, cracking down on surveillance pricing based on people’s past purchases and addressing the state’s massive water woes. De Los Santos said Democrats would crack down on Saudi-owned farms using Arizona water to grow alfalfa for export. Another top target: reigning in the state’s universal education voucher program, which allows families to tap taxpayer dollars not only for private school tuition, but also for other education-related expenses. De Los Santos points out that public dollars have been used to pay for ski trips , kitchen remodels and even lingerie . “It’s insane. It is out of control,” he said. “You've got literally thousands of dollars spent at Victoria's Secret from this program and so we're going to put an end to all of that nonsense and redirect those funds to our public schools.” Democrats also juiced their majorities Tuesday in states where they already enjoyed governing trifectas. Republicans took a beating, for example, in Chicago’s suburbs, with Democrats flipping a string of state legislative seats — held by both moderates and conservatives — and further shrinking the GOP’s once-formidable presence in the region. Republicans lost at least eight seats in the Illinois General Assembly, including six held by sitting lawmakers and two open seats. The drubbing further expands Democrats’ supermajorities in both chambers: They’ll now hold 84 out of 118 seats in the House and 45 out of 59 seats in the Senate. “It means Democrats don’t have to try to work toward the middle [on legislation], which is really where the vast majority of the electorate is,” said state GOP Rep. Dan Ugaste, who represents Chicago’s far western suburbs and was among the Republicans who lost Tuesday. Ugaste attributed the GOP losses, in part, to “many more” Democrats turning out than they did in the 2022 midterms. He also pointed to frustration with the economy and unmet expectations from the Trump administration. “The administration said on day one that they were going to improve everyone's economic situation,” Ugaste said. “And while the macro economy — businesses have orders, everyone's still employed — is at a good place, what’s hurting is whether people can afford what’s on the shelf.” In California and New York, Democrats are also poised to significantly expand their already dominant legislative majorities. In Sacramento, they control 75% of seats in the state Assembly, but with votes still being tallied they’re expected to pad that majority by at least four more seats. In New York, Democrats are poised to win at least 14 additional seats, giving them control of 158 out of 213. There’s even early speculation that — when the final results are tabulated and the electoral dust settles — that there might now be sufficient support in state legislatures to implement a presidential election system based on the popular vote. The wins also put Democratic state lawmakers in a position to help define the party’s agenda heading into 2028. “[We] need to begin to show everyone what Democrats are made of and what we're able to accomplish and how we lead,” said the DLCC’s Williams. “But also we're doing that in the context of what is expected to be a critically important and incredibly robust Democratic primary, where voters around the country are going to be able to put their mark on who the leader of the Democratic Party is going to be and where we go.” Shia Kapos contributed to this report
sources.headline: Democratic thrashing redraws the map of state power

stories.headline: Trump says immigration crackdown was too tough and contributed to midterm defeat

sources.body:
US President Donald Trump has said his immigration crackdown was "too tough", marking one of his clearest public retreats from a defining plank of his political agenda, following his party's drubbing in the midterm elections.

In an interview with CBS' 60 Minutes programme, Trump said he believed he deserved an "A plus" for drastically limiting illegal border crossings, but he had been politically "hurt" by sweeping deportations.

His acknowledgement came despite his homeland security department insisting it was not backing away from the crackdown.

Election day polling indicated immigration was the third most important issue for midterm voters, after the economy and the state of democracy.

In historically conservative states like Texas, a swing of Latino voters towards Democrats helped seal the Democratic Party's landslide majorities in Congress.

The president told 60 Minutes that immigration "both helped and hurt" his fellow Republicans in Tuesday's midterms.

"I think I got an A plus for closing up the border," he said in the programme that aired on Sunday evening.

He added: "For getting people out, I get very high marks for getting the bad ones out.

"But I get hurt because we also took people that had good jobs, that created one violation, or breaking of the law, and that was that they came into the country illegally."

"I think it was too tough," the president said.

Trump also said he'd "love to do something on immigration" with congressional Democrats, without offering details.

In a previous interview with 60 Minutes a year ago, a defiant Trump insisted his administraiton's immigration raids "haven't gone far enough".

His conciliatory words on Sunday were an abrupt change in tone from a White House statement earlier in the day to the BBC.

A spokeswoman vowed "the administration will not slow down its efforts to arrest and deport criminal illegal aliens who terrorise our communities".

The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) also showed no sign of a U-turn on Sunday.

"ICE is NOT backing away or slowing down," a DHS spokesperson told the BBC.

Following Tuesday's electoral losses, Vice-President JD Vance had appeared receptive to adjusting their immigration strategy.

"I'm open to the idea that we should change enforcement - by focusing more on businesses that hire illegal labour, for instance," Vance wrote in a lengthy online post reflecting on the results.

However, Trump's promotion on Friday of immigration hawk Stephen Miller to White House chief of staff signalled no climbdown from the administration.

Miller is widely seen as the architect of the administration's hardline immigration policy during the first and second Trump presidencies.

Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) sources told CBS that in recent weeks officials have been instructed to aim for about 2,700 arrests of illegal immigrants per day, an increase from an earlier 2,000 daily arrest target.

Enforcement sweeps this year spurred anti-ICE demonstrations in cities including Chicago, Minneapolis and Los Angeles.
sources.headline: Trump says immigration crackdown was 'too tough' and played part in midterms defeat

stories.headline: US voters reject data centers in dozens of local ballot measures

sources.body: In Tuesday’s US midterm elections, voters weighed in on more than 40 local measures on data centres, and sided against them in all but one. With Democrats taking control of Congress in January and new governors in Texas and Georgia calling for moratoriums, the AI building boom faces its toughest political test yet.
sources.headline: US voters reject AI data centres: could the backlash spread to France?

stories.headline: Spain’s right-wing bloc retains poll lead as PSOE closes gap with PP

sources.body: <p> A tres semanas para que se abran las urnas en España, la ventaja del bloque de la derecha se muestra inalterable. La suma del PP, Vox y UPN en las elecciones generales del próximo día 29 reuniría la mitad de los votos emitidos y rebasaría los 190 escaños, más de 15 por encima de la mayoría absoluta del Congreso, según la última encuesta de 40dB. para EL PAÍS y la SER. La mayor incertidumbre en estos momentos reside en quién será el más votado de entre los dos grandes partidos, ya que la diferencia entre PP y PSOE se ha acortado a dos puntos, dentro del margen de error del sondeo. Los socialistas experimentan un importante avance, pese <a href="https://elpais.com/noticias/accidente-ferrocarriles-urda-2026/" target="_self" rel="" title="https://elpais.com/noticias/accidente-ferrocarriles-urda-2026/">a la catástrofe ferroviaria de Urda</a>, mientras los grupos a su izquierda se sitúan bajo mínimos. </p><p><a href="https://elpais.com/espana/elecciones-generales/2026-11-09/el-bloque-de-la-derecha-mantiene-su-ventaja-pero-el-psoe-se-acerca-al-pp.html" target="_blank">Seguir leyendo</a></p>

stories.headline: Urda train driver reportedly tried repeatedly to reach Atocha before collision

sources.body:
Accidente ferroviario mortal en Urda (Toledo). / José Luis Roca / EPC

El pasado 28 de octubre , el país se paralizó tras el accidente de dos trenes de alta velocidad que viajaban de Madrid a Sevilla. A las 8.53 horas , un AVE colisionó contra un convoy de la empresa Iryo que se encontraba detenido en la vía, a la altura de la localidad de Urda (Toledo) . El siniestro provocó 69 fallecidos y más de 200 heridos , 10 de los cuales continúan hospitalizados, dos de ellos en la UCI del Hospital General Universitario de Toledo .

Las causas del accidente apuntan a un fallo en el sistema LZB , un mecanismo de seguridad que regula la circulación de los trenes.

Antes del choque, ambos convoyes habían quedado detenidos en distintos puntos de la misma vía . El AVE se encontraba poco después de la estación de Mora , mientras que el Iryo permanecía parado unos 27 kilómetros más al sur , a la altura de la señal de entrada de Urda. En ambos casos, el sistema indicaba que el tramo siguiente estaba ocupado .

A las 8.36 horas , el conductor del AVE recibió instrucciones para desconectar el sistema LZB y reanudar la marcha en condiciones de circulación normal. Cinco minutos después, a las 8.41 horas , el centro de control transmitió la misma indicación al maquinista del Iryo y autorizó su avance mediante una señal en verde .

Sin embargo, a las 8.48 horas , el conductor del Iryo comunicó que no había conseguido poner de nuevo en funcionamiento el sistema. Para entonces, el AVE ya había reanudado la marcha. La señalización situada entre ambos convoyes mostraba luz verde y no alertó al conductor del AVE de la presencia del otro tren. Tampoco consta que recibiera un aviso directo desde el centro de control .

Finalmente, a las 8.53 horas , el AVE, de unas 500 toneladas de peso , impactó a una velocidad de entre 160 y 200 km/h contra el Iryo, que se encontraba detenido en la vía. El tren de Renfe alcanzó los 47 km/h en apenas tres segundos , según muestra el contenido de la caja negra del tren , al que ha podido acceder en exclusiva el diario El Mundo .

La base de datos del tren embestido sitúa la colisión a las 8.53.12 horas . Tras el impacto, el convoy siguió desplazándose hasta detenerse por completo a las 8.53.21 horas , de acuerdo con los registros del sistema .

En el momento del impacto, el AVE de Renfe descargó de golpe toda la energía acumulada por su masa y velocidad sobre el tren de Iryo. La colisión deformó los últimos vagones del convoy y provocó que se desplazaran violentamente. El impacto se prolongó durante nueve segundos .

A raíz del impacto, el Iryo, formado por ocho coches y con una longitud aproximada de 200 metros , descarriló por la zona central de su composición. La fuerza del impacto, que golpeó directamente al coche 8 , se propagó por el resto del convoy y provocó que el coche 3 volcara lateralmente .

Después del choque, la maquinista informó al centro de control de Iryo de que había recibido un "impacto por alcance desde cola" . También comunicó que se encontraba "bien", aunque no conseguía contactar con el jefe de tripulantes , una de las comunicaciones previstas en caso de emergencia.
sources.headline: La caja negra del Iryo desvela que la maquinista intentó contactar hasta cuatro veces con Atocha antes del choque sin obtener respuesta

sources.body:
La maquinista del tren Iryo implicat en l' accident del 28 d'octubre a Urda hauria intentat contactar sense èxit amb el centre de control d'Adif a Atocha almenys tres vegades, segons ha avançat el diari El Mundo.

El rotatiu, que ha tingut accés al contingut de la caixa negra de l'Iryo accidentat, apunta que les trucades fallides de la maquinista de l'Iryo amb Atocha es van produir cap a les 8:32 hores, minuts abans que el tren s'aturés del tot .

La caixa negra registra que la maquinista explica a la seva companyia que, abans que s'aturés el tren, "va trucar 3 o 4 vegades" , però no va obtenir resposta.

Va ser a les 8:38 , segons la informació de la caixa negra, quan l'Iryo es va aturar totalment davant el senyal d'entrada de l'estació d'Urda, que és on es trobava quan l'AVE el va envestir.

Posteriorment, a les 8:42 , el centre de control d'Adif hauria contactat amb la maquinista de l'Iryo i aquesta els hauria confirmat que estava aturada davant del senyal d'Urda .

En aquesta trucada, una de les que es va filtrar després de l'accident , el controlador d'Adif demana a la maquinista de l'Iryo que desconnecti i torni a connectar el sistema LZB i que reprengui la marxa.

Minuts més tard, a les 8:48 , hi ha una altra comunicació entre l'Iryo i Atocha en què la maquinista assenyala que encara està aturada al mateix punt.

El xoc entre el tren AVE i l'Iryo es va produir a les 8:53 . L'AVE circulava a una velocitat d'entre 160 i 200 km/h i la topada va fer que l'Iryo accelerés fins als 47 km/h en només tres segons.

Nou segons després de l'impacte, l'Iryo es va aturar del tot i la maquinista va trucar al centre de control de la seva companyia per informar que havia rebut un "impacte per envestida des de la cua".

Segons l'acord de la jutgessa instructora de l'accident d'Urda, dictat el mateix dia de la tragèdia, la policia judicial de Toledo s'ha encarregat de confiscar i custodiar les caixes negres dels dos trens sinistrats . Les investigacions es troben sota secret de sumari des del mateix 28 d'octubre.
sources.headline: Accident d'Urda: la maquinista de l'Iryo hauria trucat almenys 3 cops a Atocha, sense resposta

stories.headline: Rodalies sets minimum services for November 10–12 strikes

sources.body:
La mobilitat en transport públic es veurà afectada durant tres dies consecutius aquesta setmana entrant. Rodalies funcionarà amb serveis mínims d'entre el 25% i el 66% del servei habitual dimarts, dia 10, dimecres, 11, i dijous, 12 de novembre, coincidint amb dues jornades de vaga dels maquinistes i la vaga general.

La primera jornada d'aturades serà dimarts, 10 de novembre, per la vaga convocada pel sindicat de maquinistes Semaf, que afecta el personal de conducció del grup Renfe durant tot el dia.

Els serveis mínims seran del 66% en les hores punta , entre les sis i quarts de deu del matí i entre les cinc i dos quarts de nou del vespre. La resta de la jornada circularà el 33% dels trens habituals.

Dimecres, 11 de novembre, hi ha prevista la vaga general de 24 hores al conjunt de l'Estat.

En aquest cas, els serveis mínims a Rodalies seran del 25% en les franges de més demanda: entre dos quarts de set i dos quarts de deu del matí, i entre dos quarts de cinc i les nou del vespre. La resta del dia no hi haurà servei garantit.

La tercera jornada d'afectacions serà dijous, 12 de novembre , també per la vaga de maquinistes de Semaf.

Aquest dia, els serveis mínims seran del 66% entre les 6.20 i les 9.20 del matí. A la tarda i al vespre, entre les 14.20 i les 17.20 i entre les 21.20 i les 23.20 es garantirà el 33% del servei habitual.

Fora d'aquestes franges, la circulació es reprendrà progressivament, tot i que Renfe adverteix que hi pot haver limitacions operatives derivades de les aturades.

Tres dies de complicacions per als usuaris. Renfe recomana als viatgers planificar els desplaçaments amb antelació i consultar els horaris i l'estat del servei abans d'iniciar el trajecte, perquè les freqüències habituals es poden veure modificades.

La companyia assegura que treballarà per minimitzar les afectacions durant les tres jornades i que mantindrà informats els usuaris a través dels canals habituals de Rodalies.

Les vagues arriben en un moment de tensió entre Renfe i els maquinistes , després que la ruptura de l'acord entre l'empresa i el sindicat majoritari hagi provocat canvis en els horaris i els torns de treball, una situació que ja ha contribuït a les incidències operatives registrades durant el cap de setmana.
sources.headline: Serveis mínims a Rodalies per les vagues del 10, 11 i 12 de novembre

sources.body: (ACN) Barcelona afronta aquesta setmana dies de mobilitzacions laborals a les portes de l’inici de la campanya de les eleccions espanyoles del 29-N . La vaga general de l’11 de novembre, convocada pels sindicats de treball i organitzacions com el Sindicat de Llogateres per reclamar sous i habitatges dignes, anirà precedida per protestes en altres sectors. Els treballadors de la indústria càrnia estan cridats a mobilitzar-se cinc dies a partir de dilluns; i els maquinistes de Renfe tenen plantejades aturades dimarts i dijous , el dia previ i posterior a la vaga general, per reclamar més seguretat ferroviària . En canvi, s’han cancel·lat les aturades previstes pels maquinistes d’Ouigo de dilluns. També et pot interessar Drets i deures dels treballadors per la vaga de l’11 de novembre: sou, serveis mínims i piquets Clara Aliaguilla 2 minuts de lectura Quan es fa i què reclama cada aturada? Habitatge (11 de novembre) La vaga general de dimecres és la primera de 24 hores que els sindicats majoritaris convoquen a l’estat des de la reforma laboral del PP del 2012 . Amb el lema “ Salaris. Habitatge. Preus “, l’aturada prevista per a dimecres, 11 de novembre, es fa per exigir millores salarials i d’ accés a l’habitatge , que consideren que s’ha convertit en un “factor d’empobriment i precarització laboral”. Situen com a prioritats la baixada dels preus dels lloguers , la prohibició de les compres especulatives, garantir contractes de lloguer indefinits i la suspensió dels desnonaments “sense alternativa residencial”. En l’àmbit laboral, demanen reduir la jornada a 35 hores i prohibir les hores extra estructurals, així com augments del salari mínim interprofessional (SMI) a 1.500 € i vincular els sous a la inflació. Com és habitual en aquest tipus de mobilitzacions, es preveu que incideixi molt en la mobilitat , amb possibles talls de carreteres o piquets informatius a les portes de grans indústries o empreses. Es preveuen mobilitzacions ja des de la nit abans, amb l’objectiu de “fer entendre al proper govern estatal que la classe treballadora pot parar el país”. Més seguretat a les vies (10 i 12 de novembre) Després del tràgic accident d’Urda , amb la mort de 69 persones, el sindicat majoritari de maquinistes, Semaf, ha convocat una vaga per als dies 10 i 12 de novembre —just abans i després de la vaga general— per reclamar mesures de seguretat . En concret, per al 10, el sindicat preveu una aturada total del servei al grup Renfe, mentre que el dia 12 les aturades seran parcials al llarg de la jornada. Semaf crida a l’aturada després de constatar una “manca de compromís real amb la seguretat” dels responsables del transport ferroviari. Millores laborals a la indústria càrnia (9-13 de novembre) La indústria càrnia ha convocat vaga entre el 9 i el 13 de novembre pel bloqueig de la negociació del conveni estatal . L’objectiu dels sindicats és pressionar les patronals perquè acceptin les millores en matèria salarial i de condicions, especialment de reducció de la jornada . La convocatòria afectarà escorxadors, sales de desfer, fàbriques d’elaboració d’embotits i serveis auxiliars d’inspecció veterinària. El sector carni és un dels principals motors de la indústria agroalimentària a Catalunya i ocupa a uns 30.000 treballadors , principalment a les comarques de Girona, Lleida, Osona i el Bages. També et pot interessar Drets i deures dels treballadors per la vaga de l’11 de novembre: sou, serveis mínims i piquets Clara Aliaguilla 2 minuts de lectura Salut i Educació continuen mobilitzats Les protestes d’aquesta setmana arriben en un moment en què tant el sector educatiu com el de la salut segueixen mobilitzats. Els metges estan en vaga indefinida des de dimecres passat , mentre que els mestres van fer diverses concentracions a les portes dels centres educatius dijous. Coincidint amb l’11-N, sindicats com la USTEC criden a la mobilització i avisen: “Sense casa no hi ha educació”. A més, els mestres tenen prevista una manifestació educativa el 21 de novembre i una vaga el 26 d’aquest mateix mes , tres dies abans de les eleccions generals. Els docents, durant la manifestació per la vaga del 8 de setembre

stories.headline: Barcelona tenants’ union takes city to court over affordable housing rule

sources.body:
El Sindicat de Llogateres portarà l’Ajuntament de Barcelona als tribunals per la seva actuació en la rehabilitació d’un edifici de Consell de Cent, 538 , propietat de l’empresa Vandor. L’entitat acusa el consistori de no haver fet complir la reserva del 30% d’habitatge protegit que correspondria aplicar en aquesta finca. El recurs contenciós administratiu denuncia el silenci de l’Ajuntament davant una petició que el sindicat va registrar el 13 de març i que demanava obrir un expedient per obligar l’empresa a complir la normativa.

Segons denuncia l’entitat, el cas exemplifica les dificultats per fer efectiva una mesura que permetria ampliar el parc de pisos protegits sense necessitat de construir-ne de nous amb diners públics. El conflicte arriba en plena onada de reivindicacions per l’habitatge i a les portes de la vaga general, amb el Sindicat de Llogateres entre els col·lectius impulsors.

La normativa del 30% estableix que les promocions de nova construcció i les grans rehabilitacions han de reservar una part dels habitatges a protecció oficial. En el cas de Consell de Cent, una inspecció municipal va concloure que les obres de Vandor constituïen una gran rehabilitació i que, per tant, s’hi haurien de destinar vuit dels 28 pisos a habitatge protegit . Segons el sindicat, l’empresa ja ha reformat 15 habitatges de l’edifici, però ha tramitat les actuacions mitjançant procediments previstos per a obres menors. L’entitat demana ara que el jutjat reclami a l’Ajuntament tots els expedients d’obres per aclarir com s’han autoritzat les reformes i per què no s’ha actuat després de la inspecció.

La batalla judicial no es limitarà a aquesta finca. El Sindicat de Llogateres ha anunciat que presentarà dos recursos més pels edificis de Nàpols, 206, i Rocafort, 219 . En el primer cas, la reserva del 30% suposaria dos pisos protegits, mentre que en el segon n’afectaria quatre. En conjunt, els tres contenciosos afecten 14 habitatges protegits.

L’empresa rebutja que les obres hagin de comportar l’aplicació de la reserva del 30%. Vandor assegura que hi ha una “discrepància tècnica de fons” sobre la naturalesa de les actuacions i defensa, basant-se en l’assessorament d’un despatx d’arquitectura, que no es tracta d’obres majors que obliguin a reservar pisos protegits. La companyia afirma que ha presentat les al·legacions i els recursos corresponents, que encara estan pendents de resolució municipal, i manté la disposició a dialogar. L’Ajuntament, per la seva banda, ha defensat la necessitat de mantenir la mesura del 30%, però considera que cal perfeccionar-la perquè sigui més efectiva. El consistori assenyala que fins ara ha permès generar 39 habitatges protegits de promoció privada a Barcelona, 16 dels quals procedents de grans rehabilitacions. El Sindicat, però, sosté que no es pot valorar l’eficàcia de la norma si no se n’exigeix el compliment.
sources.headline: El Sindicat de Llogateres porta l’Ajuntament als tribunals per incomplir el 30% d’habitatge protegit

stories.headline: Torre Baró residents say flood damage remains unrepaired a month later

sources.body: Les conseqüències dels aiguats de principis d’octubre es continuen notant als barris de muntanya . Els veïns de Torre Baró , per exemple, lamenten que hi ha punts que segueixen pràcticament igual que després de l’episodi de pluges. És el cas del passatge de Carreras, on hi va haver una esllavissada , on es van col·locar tanques per frenar la caiguda de terra. Ara bé, Gabriel Raya, veí del carrer, creu que no és una barrera gaire efectiva, sobretot si uns aiguats de la mateixa intensitat es tornen a produir: “ No soc geòleg, però pot ser molt fàcil que torni a caure “. Uns metres mes enllà, al carrer de Sant Feliu de Codines, la pluja van provocar un esvoranc al marge de la calçada. Ara el forat està acordonat, però continua sense tapar. El Pablo Torrer, veí de la zona que hi passeja sovint, alerta: “Caurà fins i tot la casa que hi ha al costat”. A més, l’accident també impedeix que pel carrer hi circuli l’autobús de la manera habitual, perquè només un dels tres vehicles que fa la línia —el més petit— hi pot passar: “ Va un mes que estem sense autobús, com als anys 60 “. També et pot interessar Els barris de muntanya, els més damnificats per la pluja: esllavissades i un rescat de pel·lícula Marta de San Nicolás Núria Granados Ricard Cosialls 3 minuts de lectura Demanen celeritat a l’Ajuntament “ El veí ha d’arreglar el carrer? Ha de ser l’Ajuntament “, recalca Torrer, que assegura que han estat els mateixos veïns els qui han fet molts dels arranjaments. De fet, Raya explica que l’ajuda no va arribar fins al tercer dia i que qui va parar el cop va ser el veïnat: “El primer pas el vam fer nosaltres, perquè, si no, no podíem ni caminar pel carrer”. Un mes després de tot plegat, demanen celeritat en les actuacions municipals , però de moment diuen que no hi ha resposta del consistori. Se senten abandonats, però no és cosa nova: “És com si Torre Baró sempre anés a part”. També et pot interessar Estudien fer un pont ferroviari nou sobre el Besòs que suporti futures riuades Núria Granados 1 minut de lectura
sources.headline: Torre Baró, un mes després dels aiguats: “És molt fàcil que tot torni a caure”

stories.headline: Barcelona gives initial approval to Vall d’Hebron public-space renovation

sources.body: L’Ajuntament de Barcelona ha aprovat inicialment el projecte de reurbanització de l’espai públic dels interiors d’illa que delimiten els carrers de Juan de Mena i Pare Mariana i el passeig de la Vall d’Hebron , al barri de la Vall d’Hebron. El projecte d’arranjament afecta una superfície total de més de 13.800 m² i té un pressupost de 8,4 M€. Les obres de remodelació s’iniciaran la primavera del 2027 i s’allargaran fins a finals del 2028. Es tracta d’una actuació a través de la qual es vol impulsar una millora urbana general i integral de tot aquest entorn per facilitar l’ accessibilitat i el pas dels vianants ; crear itineraris amb pendents més suaus, i generar llocs d’estada i esbarjo també per a la mainada, amb zones de jocs infantils , mobiliari urbà i reforç de la il·luminació del carrer . Sense cotxes ni places d’aparcament Per fer-ho possible, l’ eliminarà una zona d’estacionament de vehicles propera al passeig de la Vall d’Hebron: 35 places de cotxe i 31 places de motocicleta. A més, també es prohibirà el trànsit rodat dins de tot l’àmbit, excepte per a operacions de càrrega i descàrrega i per a vehicles d’emergència. La desaparició de la zona d’aparcament farà guanyar a l’entorn de 800 m² d’espai lliure i d’ús públic . Es suavitzaran els 15 metres de desnivell La millora de la mobilitat i la introducció d’elements d’accessibilitat és també un dels objectius destacats d’aquest projecte, ja que l’àmbit d’actuació té desnivells de fins a 15 metres . Fins ara aquest desnivell se salva amb escales i graons. El projecte planteja crear itineraris accessibles amb rampes més suaus que facilitin la mobilitat tant en sentit longitudinal com transversal, per eliminar barreres. També et pot interessar Barcelona invertirà més de 150 M € per fer zones verdes en espais en desús i per guanyar més ombra Maria Solans Sílvia Gutiérrez 4 minuts de lectura Adaptació al canvi climàtic Amb el projecte, es vol reconnectar aquest veïnat amb tot l’entorn, i alhora implantar una arquitectura més identitària, preservant aquells paviments i elements urbans que hi són propis. Aquesta actuació forma part del Programa d’espais de proximitat i interiors, una estratègia municipal emmarcada en el Pla clima que té com a objectiu incrementar i transformar els espais quotidians de la ciutat, posant l’accent en el verd, l’ombra, la renaturalització i l’adaptació al canvi climàtic. El projecte preveu mantenir i millorar la vegetació existent , molt abundant en aquest sector: es farà una revisió acurada de l’estat dels arbres i arbustos, per substituir els que no es trobin en bon estat, i s’hi incrementarà el verd . També et pot interessar Barcelona desplega el Pla clima: 1.800 M € fins al 2030 per reduir 1 milió de tones de CO₂ Marta Casals Torres 3 minuts de lectura
sources.headline: Aprovada la reurbanització dels interiors d’illa de quatre grans blocs de la Vall d’Hebron

sources.body:
El Ayuntamiento de Barcelona da luz verde a la reforma del interior de la isla de la calle Juan de Mena, en la Vall d’Hebron. / Ajuntament de Barcelona

El Ayuntamiento de Barcelona ha aprobado inicialmente el proyecto para reurbanizar los interiores de manzana situados entre las calles de Juan de Mena, Pare Mariana y el paseo de la Vall d’Hebron , en el distrito de Horta-Guinardó del barrio de la Vall d'Hebron , una zona formada por un conjunto de cuatro grandes bloques de finales de los años 60.

La actuación se incluye dentro del Programa d’Espais de Proximitat i Interiors del Plan Clima del consistorio, cuyo objetivo es incrementar y transformar los espacios cotidianos de la ciudad, haciendo hincapié en las zonas verdes, la sombra, la renaturalización y la adaptación al cambio climático .

El proyecto pretende impulsar la mejora urbana del entorno para facilitar la accesibilidad y el paso a los peatones. Para ello, se reforzará la iluminación de la calle, adaptándola a los nuevos criterios energéticos y de calidad lumínica actuales. También se renovará el mobiliario urbano, se crearán nuevas áreas de estancia y se modernizarán las zonas de juegos infantiles , con nuevos juegos para el disfrute de los niños. Asimismo, está previsto mejorar el sistema de recogida del agua y la red de alcantarillado en todo el entorno.

Además, se allanarán los caminos con pendientes para facilitar la movilidad y se establecerán espacios de descanso para los vecinos, ya que es un punto con desniveles pronunciados. Concretamente, el desnivel entre la calle Juan de Mena y el passeig de la Vall d'Hebron es de unos 15 metros .

El Ayuntamiento también estudiará en profundidad la posición del mobiliario urbano, como papeleras, bancos y sillas, para reubicarlos en los itinerarios de paseo.

Entre las múltiples iniciativas, destaca la eliminación de un punto de estacionamiento de vehículos , ubicado actualmente en el área interior más próxima al paseo de la Vall d’Hebron. La desaparición de la zona de aparcamiento supone la eliminación de 35 plazas para coches y 31 plazas para motocicletas , lo que permitirá ganar alrededor de 800 m² de nuevo espacio libre y de uso público . También se suprimirá el tráfico en todo el ámbito, excepto para las operaciones de carga y descarga y para los vehículos de emergencia .

La operación plantea reparar el pavimento roto y desgastado por el tiempo y unificarlo con distintos tipos de acabados. Actualmente, en el entorno afectado existe una mezcla de pavimentos, por lo que el cambio tendrá un gran impacto a nivel paisajístico.

En la zona interior entre los edificios, los acabados serán de cerámica, hormigón o arena , y se utilizará caucho o sauló en las áreas de juegos infantiles, dependiendo del tipo de juego. En las zonas de paso y perimetrales se introducirá un adoquín de cuatro franjas .

El antes y después de la isla con las modificaciones. / Ajuntament de Barcelona

La reforma transformará el espacio con más vegetación : se llevará a cabo una revisión del estado de los árboles y arbustos para ponerlos en valor o sustituir aquellos que no se encuentren en buen estado, y se incrementará la presencia de zonas verdes con la plantación de nuevos ejemplares.
sources.headline: El Ayuntamiento de Barcelona da luz verde a la reforma del interior de la isla de la calle Juan de Mena, en la Vall d’Hebron

stories.headline: Centuries-old Gothic Quarter bookshop closes, citing tourism pressure

sources.body:
Aquest octubre, el TOT Barcelona explicava que una botiga centenària del barri Gòtic tancava. Es tracta de Magatzems del Pilar , al carrer de la Boqueria, 43, dedicada als teixits per a la llar. Ha abaixat la persiana després de cinc generacions de la mateixa família al capdavant del negoci. Ara, aquesta clausura se’n sumarà una altra, la de la llibreria Rodés, oberta el 1920. Des de fa tres dècades ocupava un local al carrer dels Banys Nous, 8.

El seu propietari, David Rodés, n’ha explicat els motius en un vídeo al diari Línia , que n’ha avançat la notícia. La llibreria plega al carrer dels Banys Nous per l’increment del preu del lloguer i perquè “la turistització ens ha posat fora del mercat”, diu Rodés. “Tot el Gòtic ha quedat arrasat comercialment”, denuncia. Anys enrere, en aquesta zona del Gòtic hi havia una vintena de llibreries de vell i antiquàries importants. “Totes han anat desapareixent o canviant de barri”.

La intenció de Rodés és intentar traspassar la llibreria, però reconeix que és difícil per la tipologia de negocis que obren al barri. “Estic envoltat de botigues de roba, records, ungles, empanades…, una al costat de l’altra”, subratlla a Línia .

La història de la llibreria Rodés es remunta a fa cent sis anys. El fundador en va ser Adolfo Rodés, avi del David. Segons va explicar el Gremi de Llibreters de Vell en un reel a Instagram, en aquest comerç es va crear el Gremi de Llibreters de Vell de Catalunya. La llibreria està especialitzada en llibres de ciències, però també ven joies antiquàries, com postals, mapes, gravats i, evidentment, llibres.

Al llarg dels darrers anys, diferents botigues històriques han tancat al Gòtic, per exemple la papereria Conesa , del carrer de Petritxol, després de setanta-cinc anys al barri; la Casa Jornet , un comerç de mobles del 1901 situat al carrer de la Palla que era visitat per Antoni Gaudí , i la Casa de les Sabatilles després de prop de vuit dècades. Tot i que la seva vida va començar al Gòtic, va haver de deixar el barri i es va instal·lar en un local municipal al carrer de Sant Pere més Alt, però va acabar plegant.

Una llibreria del Gòtic que va aconseguir salvar-se va ser la Sant Jordi, al carrer de Ferran. La llibreria Sant Jordi va tancar a finals de febrer del 2025 a l’espera de ser traspassada. El desembre del 2024 havia mort prematurament el seu titular, en Josep Morales. Aquest pròxim 10 de desembre farà un any que va reobrir de la mà de l’agència de viatges Temps d’Oci, un espai on conviuen la passió per la lectura, el plaer per la gastronomia i l’activitat cultural.
sources.headline: Tanca la llibreria Rodés, un negoci centenari del barri Gòtic: “La turistització ens ha posat fora del mercat”
